headline: 本周影剧：人性本兽领跑，幻视任务首播
summary: 本周影市由《人性本兽》《狄仁杰之狼人劫》等领跑；新剧《幻视任务》首播，《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》热播，待映还有《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《人性本兽》《另一个妈妈》《火柴盒大电影》等本周居前。
industryHighlights.en: Film heat: Human Nature the Beast, The Other Mother, and Matchbox lead this week.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《幻视任务》《乌鸦学园》《魔女嘉莉》等上线。
industryHighlights.en: New TV premieres: Vision Quest, Raven Academy, and Carrie debut.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧持续：《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》《母狮》《末日地堡》。
industryHighlights.en: Returning hits: Reacher, Green Lantern Corps, Lioness, and Silo.

industryHighlights.text: 待映待播：《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《夜曲》《水晶湖》等蓄势。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming: Avengers 5, Dune 3, Nocturne, and Crystal Lake build buzz.

headlineEn: This Week in Film & TV: Human Nature Leads, Vision Quest Premieres
summaryEn: This week’s film slate is led by Human Nature the Beast and Detective Dee: Werewolf Crisis; Vision Quest premieres, while Reacher and Green Lantern Corps stay hot, and Avengers 5 and Dune 3 are upcoming.
